summary: A man married to two wives died. The first wife collects her kesubah before the second, but if the first wife died before him, the second wife comes before the first wife's heirs.

chunks.he: מִי שֶׁהָיָה נָשׂוּי שְׁתֵּי נָשִׁים וּמֵת,
chunks.en: One who was married to two wives and died:
chunks.st: one who was married to two women and died,

chunks.en: the first comes before the second,
chunks.st: the first woman he married precedes the second
chunks.stMore: in collecting the payment specified in her marriage contract if there are insufficient funds to pay both, because her document is dated earlier. So too, if the wives died after their husband before they received payment for their marriage contracts,

chunks.en: and the first one's heirs come before the second one's heirs.
chunks.st: the heirs of the first wife precede the heirs of the second wife in collecting these payments.

chunks.en: If he married the first and she died,
chunks.st: If he married a first woman and she subsequently died,

chunks.en: then he married a second and he died,
chunks.st: and he then married a second woman and he subsequently died,

chunks.en: the second and her heirs come before the first one's heirs.
chunks.st: the second wife and her heirs precede the heirs of the first
chunks.stMore: wife. This is because the marriage contract of the second wife is considered a debt that the estate of the deceased is required to pay, whereas the claim of the heirs of the first wife is based on the stipulation in the marriage contract that male children inherit their mother’s marriage contract. Heirs receive their share of the estate only from property that remains after all debts have been settled.

summary: When there is only enough money for the two wives' kesubos, the sons split the father's property equally. Only if there is at least a dinar extra does each group of sons take its own mother's kesubah.

chunks.st: but there is only enough in the estate to pay the value of the two marriage contracts,

chunks.st: distribute the estate equally
chunks.stMore: among themselves according to the biblical laws of inheritance.

chunks.st: If there was a surplus of a dinar left there,
chunks.stMore: in the estate, beyond the value of the two marriage contracts,

chunks.en: these take their mother's kesubah
chunks.st: then these sons collect their mother’s marriage contract

chunks.en: and those take their mother's kesubah.
chunks.st: and those sons collect their mother’s marriage contract,
chunks.stMore: and the remaining property valued at a dinar is divided equally among all the sons.

chunks.en: If the orphans said,

chunks.stMore: i.e., we agree to evaluate the property we will receive for our mother’s marriage settlement at a value higher than the market value so that there will be a dinar left in the estate after the two marriage contracts have been paid,

chunks.en: so they can take their mother's kesubah,
chunks.st: so that they can collect their mother’s marriage contract,

chunks.en: it is not like what they already hold.

summary: A man died leaving three wives with kesubos of one hundred, two hundred and three hundred, and not enough money. The mishnah shows how they split what there is, and partners split the same way.

chunks.he: מִי שֶׁהָיָה נָשׂוּי שָׁלשׁ נָשִׁים וּמֵת,
chunks.en: One who was married to three wives and died:
chunks.st: one who was married to three women and died and

chunks.en: this one's kesubah is one hundred, and that
chunks.st: the marriage contract of this wife was for one hundred dinars and

chunks.en: one's two hundred, and this one's three
chunks.st: the marriage contract of this second wife was for two hundred dinars, and the marriage contract of this third wife was for three hundred,
chunks.stMore: and all three contracts were issued on the same date so that none of the wives has precedence over any of the others,

chunks.en: hundred, and there is only one hundred there,
chunks.st: and the total value of the estate is only one hundred dinars,

chunks.en: they split it equally.
chunks.st: the wives divide the estate equally.

chunks.en: If there were two hundred there,
chunks.st: If there were two hundred dinars in the estate,

chunks.en: the one of one hundred takes fifty,
chunks.st: the one whose marriage contract was for one hundred dinars takes fifty dinars,

chunks.en: the ones of two hundred and of three hundred
chunks.st: while those whose contracts were for two hundred and three hundred

chunks.en: take three gold dinars each.
chunks.st: dinars take three dinars of gold each,
chunks.stMore: which are the equivalent of seventy-five silver dinars.

chunks.en: If there were three hundred there,
chunks.st: If there were three hundred dinars in the estate,

chunks.en: the one of one hundred takes fifty,
chunks.st: the one whose marriage contract was for one hundred dinars takes fifty dinars,

chunks.en: and the one of two hundred
chunks.st: the one whose contract was for two hundred dinars

chunks.en: takes one hundred, and the one of three hundred
chunks.st: takes one hundred dinars, and the one whose contract was for three hundred dinars

chunks.en: takes six gold dinars.
chunks.st: takes six dinars of gold,
chunks.stMore: the equivalent of one hundred and fifty silver dinars.

chunks.en: And so three people who put money into one purse:
chunks.st: Similarly, three individuals who deposited money into a purse,
chunks.stMore: i.e., invested different amounts of money into a joint business venture:

chunks.en: if they lost or earned,
chunks.st: If they incurred a loss or earned a profit,

chunks.en: this is how they split.
chunks.st: and now choose to dissolve the partnership, they divide the assets in this manner,
chunks.stMore: i.e., based upon the amount that each of them initially invested in the partnership.

summary: When a man with four wives dies, the first wife collects before the second, and so on, and each one swears to the next. Ben Nanas says the last one swears too, and kesubos from the same day go by the hour.

chunks.he: מִי שֶׁהָיָה נָשׂוּי אַרְבַּע נָשִׁים וּמֵת,
chunks.en: One who was married to four wives and died,
chunks.st: one who was married to four women and died,

chunks.en: the first comes before the second,
chunks.st: the woman he married first precedes the woman he married second in claiming her marriage contract,

chunks.en: and the second before the third,
chunks.st: the second precedes the third,

chunks.en: and the third before the fourth.
chunks.st: and the third precedes the fourth.

chunks.en: The first swears to the second,
chunks.explain: That she did not take anything that was not hers.
chunks.st: And the first wife takes an oath to the second
chunks.stMore: that she has taken nothing from the jointly owned properties of the estate in an unlawful manner,

chunks.en: and the second to the third,
chunks.st: and the second takes an oath to the third,

chunks.en: and the third to the fourth,
chunks.st: and the third to the fourth.

chunks.en: and the fourth is paid without an oath.
chunks.st: The fourth wife is paid her share without having to take an oath.

chunks.en: Ben Nanas says,
chunks.st: Ben Nanas says:

chunks.en: Just because she is last, does she gain?
chunks.st: Should she gain this advantage merely because she is last?
chunks.stMore: After all, she too is being paid from property that would otherwise go to the orphans. Rather,

chunks.he: אַף הִיא לֹא תִפָּרַע אֶלָּא בִשְׁבוּעָה.
chunks.en: She too is paid only with an oath.
chunks.st: she too is not paid without an oath.

chunks.en: If they were all written on the same day,
chunks.st: However, if all of the marriage contracts were issued on the same day,

chunks.he: כָּל הַקּוֹדֶמֶת לַחֲבֶרְתָּהּ אֲפִלּוּ שָׁעָה אַחַת,
chunks.en: whoever came before the other even by one hour
chunks.st: whichever wife’s marriage contract precedes that of another, even by a single hour,

chunks.he: זָכְתָה. וְכָךְ הָיוּ כוֹתְבִין בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם שָׁעוֹת.
chunks.en: gets it first. And so in Yerushalayim they wrote the hours.
chunks.st: has acquired the right to be paid first. And so, the practice in Jerusalem was that they would write the hours
chunks.stMore: when the documents had been signed on the documents, in order to enable the document holder to demonstrate that his or her document preceded that of another.

chunks.en: If they were all written in the same hour
chunks.st: If all the contracts were issued in the same hour

chunks.en: and there is only one hundred there,
chunks.st: and there is only one hundred dinars from which to pay all of them,

chunks.en: they split it equally.
chunks.st: all of the women divide the money equally.

summary: A man with two wives sold a field, and only the first wife promised the buyer not to take it. Each one can take the field from the next, round and round, until they make a deal.

chunks.en: One who was married to two wives,
chunks.st: one who was married to two women

chunks.en: and he sold his field,
chunks.st: and sold his field,

chunks.en: and the first wife wrote to the buyer, I have no claim
chunks.st: and the wife whom he married first wrote to the purchaser: I do not have any legal dealings

chunks.en: and no say with you,
chunks.st: or involvement with you,

chunks.en: the second takes it from the buyer,
chunks.st: then the second wife, who did not relinquish her claim to repossess this property, may appropriate the field from the purchaser
chunks.stMore: as payment of her marriage contract. This is because the property was liened for the payment of her marriage contract before it was sold to this purchaser.

chunks.en: and the first from the second,
chunks.st: Then, the first wife can appropriate the field from the second
chunks.stMore: as payment for her marriage contract, since her marriage contract predates that of the second wife.

chunks.en: and the buyer from the first,
chunks.st: The purchaser can then appropriate the field from the first
chunks.stMore: wife, due to the fact that she relinquished her rights vis-à-vis the purchaser.

chunks.he: וְחוֹזְרוֹת חֲלִילָה עַד שֶׁיַּעֲשׂוּ פְשָׁרָה בֵינֵיהֶם.
chunks.en: and they go round and round until they make a deal between them.
chunks.st: They continue to do so according to this cycle [ḥalila] until they agree on a compromise between them.

chunks.en: And the same with a lender,
chunks.st: And so too, with regard to a creditor,

chunks.en: and the same with a woman lender.
chunks.st: and so too, with regard to a female creditor.
